candidates.simpler_alternative: Use one heading-aware awk command that retains only the final `## ` section.

selection.reason: It is the only candidate with fresh real-task friction and a one-command discriminating test.

pre_result_plan.real_task: Read the latest docs/SESSIONS.md entry during mandatory startup.
pre_result_plan.observed_problem: The natural baseline exposed 170 lines and 11918 UTF-8 bytes to obtain one final section.
pre_result_plan.hypothesis: One heading-aware read returns the identical complete final section with at least 50% fewer bytes and no additional task action.
pre_result_plan.quality_control: The intervention must equal the file slice from its last `## ` heading through EOF byte-for-byte, retain the Session 045 heading and exact-next-step tail, and use one read action.
pre_result_plan.overhead: Count command setup, the read action, count/hash verification, reporting, tests, checkpoint maintenance and publication; do not translate bytes into token, time or LLM-quality claims.
pre_result_plan.stop_condition: If identity fails, the intervention needs more than one read action, or savings are below 50%, reject the practice and change no stable instruction.

result.reason: The one-command intervention retained the exact required section and exceeded the predeclared byte threshold without adding a task action; adopt the practice as an instruction, not a helper.
limitations: One file and one session; section size and tail choice vary over time.
UTF-8 bytes are not token counts and do not establish faster work, comprehension, decision quality or broader LLM improvement.
The baseline tail size was an agent judgment, not a fixed repository command.
Verification and reporting overhead exceed the saved bytes in this experimental session; future use avoids that measurement overhead.
